# Copilot instructions

Before making changes in this repository, read and follow [`skill.md`](../skill.md).
It is the source of truth for TaskBoard's project context, requirements,
architecture, security constraints, and validation expectations.

Inspect the current repository state before assuming a technology or design
choice has been made. Keep changes focused, protect credentials and persistent
data, run relevant validation, and report only results that were actually
verified.
